title: European Commission Fines TechCo 1.8 Billion Euros

events.headline: European Commission Fines TechCo 1.8 Billion Euros
events.summary: The European Commission fined TechCo 1.8 billion euros on Tuesday for abusing its dominant position in the online search market. title: Nearly 200 Nations Agree to Phase Down Coal Use by 2035

events.headline: Nearly 200 Nations Agree to Phase Down Coal Use by 2035
events.summary: Nearly 200 countries signed a climate pact on Tuesday to phase down coal use by 2035. The agreement followed two weeks of negotiations. The deal establishes a timeline and specific targets for reducing emissions. Both sources report the same deadline and participant count.
